name: Start EMR Serverless Job
description: This node can be use to start an EMR Serverless Job.

fields.name: Name
fields.title: Task Name
fields.description: Unique name of the task in airflow DAG.

fields.name: ApplicationId
fields.title: Application ID
fields.description: If Application ID is empty, the step tries to pick the Application ID from previous create EMRServerless Application node(task)

fields.name: EntryPoint
fields.title: Main class
fields.description: Required for .jar script files. Main class is the entry point for the application.

fields.name: retry_exponential_backoff
fields.title: Retry Exponential Backoff
fields.description: Allow progressive longer waits between retries by using exponential backoff algorithm on retry delay

fields.name: deferrable
fields.title: Deferrable
fields.description: When set to True, the task enters deferred mode during long waits. This frees the Apache Airflow worker slot and lets the Triggerer monitor the job asynchronously until completion.

fields.name: wait_for_completion
fields.title: Wait For Completion
fields.description: When set to True, the task does not finish immediately after submitting the job. It waits until the Amazon EMR Serverless job reaches a success or failure state before continuing downstream tasks.

fields.name: waiter_max_attempts
fields.title: Waiter Max attempts
fields.description: Sets the total number of polling attempts before timing out.A value of 50 allows up to 50 checks. Combined with waiter_delay=60, this gives a maximum wait time of about 50 minutes.

fields.name: waiter_delay
fields.title: Waiter Delay
fields.description: Defines how many seconds the operator waits between each job status poll. A value of 60 means the EMR Serverless job state is checked once every minute.
